verdict.rationale: The evidence documents PagerDuty's REST API, Events API v2, webhooks, published OpenAPI schemas, an interactive API reference with code samples, and an official MCP server. None of it names an official client SDK or library for any language. OpenAPI schemas and raw HTTP APIs are building blocks a developer could use to generate or write a client, and the MCP server is a separate capability, so none of this earns credit for official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
